community_list_entries.name: MemUse: Moving Memory Evaluation from Direct QA to Natural Integration in Long-Term Human-AI Conversation

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Releases a 4-month deployment corpus (40 users, 1,872 diary-companion sessions) and MemUse: 72 real user-cued memory moments, 316 decomposed questions, scored for Natural Integration by a GPT-5.4-nano judge. Memories are users' personal life details from earlier sessions.
